title: Multi-step sweet messages flow with virtual chocolate gift box

requirements.summary: Convert the Chocolate Day experience into a multi-step guided flow with Next/Back navigation, progress indicator, and preserved Dairy Milk Fruit & Nut reveal dialog.
acceptanceCriteria: The experience contains multiple steps/pages (at least 3 total) presented as a guided flow.
Users can move forward/backward using clearly labeled buttons (e.g., “Next”, “Back”).
A progress indicator (e.g., Step 1 of N / dots) is visible and updates correctly.
The existing Dairy Milk Fruit & Nut card and message reveal modal still work and are reachable from within the flow.
Navigation and dialogs are keyboard accessible (Tab/Shift+Tab, Enter/Space), with visible focus states.

file_operations.description: Refactor the current single-page layout into a multi-step flow driven by local step state (at least 3 steps), including clear Next/Back controls and a visible progress indicator. Keep ChocolateGallery and ChocolateMessageReveal integrated as a reachable step so the Dairy Milk Fruit & Nut reveal interaction remains available. Use shadcn-ui Button for navigation actions; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a lightweight progress indicator component (e.g., Step X of N and/or dots) with accessible labeling (aria-current for the active step) and styling that matches the romantic theme in light/dark modes. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a reusable navigation control component that renders Back/Next buttons, correctly disables them at the ends of the flow, and supports keyboard activation. Use shadcn-ui Button for consistent styling; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add new romantic English message content across at least two additional steps, matching the existing romantic theme and keeping the favorite chocolate singular.
acceptanceCriteria: At least 2 additional pages/steps contain new romantic message content beyond the existing chocolate reveal message.
All added user-facing copy is in English and reads naturally.
The new pages visually match the existing romantic theme (rose/pink/amber palette) and remain readable in light/dark modes.
No copy implies multiple favorite chocolates; the favorite remains singular (Dairy Milk Fruit & Nut).

file_operations.description: Add a dedicated step component containing new romantic, heartfelt English copy praising him (no mention of multiple favorite chocolates), styled to match the existing rose/pink/amber theme and readable in dark mode. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a second dedicated step component with additional romantic English copy (distinct from the reveal message), maintaining the singular favorite chocolate framing and ensuring good contrast in both light/dark modes. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire the new sweet message step components into the multi-step flow order and ensure they participate in Next/Back navigation and progress indicator counts. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add a dedicated virtual chocolates gifting step featuring a rich box-of-chocolates visual with an accessible open/reveal interaction and a short romantic note.
acceptanceCriteria: A dedicated step/page exists that prominently shows a ‘box full of chocolates’ visual.
The box view includes a lightweight interaction (e.g., an “Open the box” / “Reveal chocolates” button or tap target) that reveals the chocolates and a short romantic note.
The interaction is accessible: can be triggered via keyboard; respects reduced-motion preferences where applicable (no mandatory heavy animation).
The gifting experience is decorative/virtual and does not introduce additional selectable chocolate options that conflict with the single-favorite-chocolate gallery.

file_operations.description: Implement the virtual gifting step that shows a closed gift box initially and reveals the open box filled with chocolates plus a short romantic note after an accessible user action (button). Keep the chocolates decorative (no selectable options). Use shadcn-ui Button for the reveal interaction; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Insert the virtual chocolate gift step into the flow and ensure it updates the progress indicator and works with Next/Back navigation. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add and wire the required generated static image assets for the virtual chocolate box step under frontend/public/assets/generated (frontend-only).
acceptanceCriteria: New images are added under frontend/public/assets/generated and referenced via /assets/generated/... paths.
The gifting step/page renders correctly with the new assets in both light and dark mode.
No backend code is added for image serving.

file_operations.description: Add the required generated image asset for the closed gift box state used by the virtual gifting step.
Add the required generated image asset for the open gift box filled with assorted chocolates used by the virtual gifting step.
Add the required generated seamless pattern background asset used decoratively within the virtual gifting step.

Reference and render the new static assets from frontend/public via their paths: /assets/generated/chocolate-gift-box-closed.dim_1200x800.png, /assets/generated/chocolate-gift-box-open.dim_1200x800.png, and /assets/generated/chocolate-pattern-bg.dim_1600x900.png. Ensure the layout remains readable in light/dark modes and the assets are purely static (no backend involvement). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
